title: At the Iron Gate  (लोहे के फाटक पर)

segments.t: आँगन के पेड़ के नीचे केलेब और उसका बड़ा भाई ओवेन तीन साल बाद आमने-सामने हैं। केलेब हैना के सिखाए वही तीन सरल वाक्य बोलता है, और हैना गरम चाय रखकर आँगन उनके नाम छोड़ देती है। पहले पूरा दृश्य सुनिए।
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
अब आइए इस भावुक मिलाप के एक-एक वाक्य को समझते हैं।
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
'तो “दादाजी की निशानी रखने वाला कोई व्यक्ति” शुरू से तुम ही थे, केलेब।'
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
'नमस्ते, ओवेन। आज आने का धन्यवाद।'
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
'मैंने उस पोस्टकार्ड पर तुम्हारी साफ़ चौकोर लिखावट दो सेकंड में पहचान ली थी।'
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
'रुको, तुम्हें पता था कि वह मेरी तरफ़ से है और फिर भी तुम आए?'
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
'ज़ाहिर है मैं आया। तुम एक रहस्यमयी पर्ची के पीछे क्यों छिपे?'
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
'क्योंकि मुझे डर था कि तुम अब भी नाराज़ होगे। इन तीन सालों में मुझे तुम्हारी बहुत याद आई।'
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
'तीन ज़िद्दी साल... सच कहूँ, छोटे भाई, मुझे भी तुम्हारी बहुत याद आई।'
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
'माफ़ कीजिएगा, सज्जनो। यह रही गरम चाय, और गरमागरम नींबू केक बस आ ही रहा है।'
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
'नींबू केक? रुको, इन्हें शुक्रवार वाले नींबू केक के बारे में कैसे पता चला?'
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
'बैठ जाओ, ओवेन, अपना भारी कोट उतार दो, और इस नीले सूटकेस को देखो।'
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
'क्या यह दादाजी की कार्यशाला वाला वही पुराना गहरा नीला बैग है?'
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
'जितना समय चाहिए आराम से लीजिए। यह आँगन आपका है।'
आइए पूरा दृश्य एक बार फिर स्वाभाविक गति में सुनते हैं।
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
तीन ज़िद्दी सालों की बर्फ़ पिघल चुकी है और दोनों भाई दादाजी की कार्यशाला वाले गहरे नीले सूटकेस के पास बैठ गए हैं! अगले दृश्य में खुलता है सफ़ेद काग़ज़ का पैकेट।
See you soon!
